combo_label: The Sunday Roast × Horses & Riding × Ancient Egypt

entries.clue: Short familiar name for the white-headed brassica, baked in cheese sauce
Small thin sausage, wrapped in rashers beside the Christmas bird
Yard visitor with an anvil in the van, rasp in hand and nails in his mouth
Stone from a Delta town whose three scripts unlocked the glyphs
Upswept rear lip of the saddle, right behind the rider's seat
Call meaning stop, addressed to the animal and not the driver
Falcon-headed son who avenged his slain father to win the throne
Streaky fatty cut of pork, slow-roasted until the top goes glassy
Two-beat pace with the legs swinging in diagonal pairs
Translucent white stone cut into vessels and lamps
